model: Qwen3.8 Flash-Next Unsloth UD-Q4_K_XL + shared-Q8_0 MTP
hardware: AMD Strix Halo gfx1151, 128 GB unified memory, TuneD accelerator-performance
toolchain: Fedora 44 container, ROCm 10.0.0 (amdrocm-core-devel10.0-gfx1151), GCC 16 host C++, RelWithDebInfo release preset; identical for every binary (not the Nix pin)
method: HTTP gufo serve --sessions 1 --context 65536 --think off --speculative mtp; fresh server per run, one short greedy warm-up, then a fixed ordered request list (shallow, then 32K behind a shared ~30K-token repository-text prefix restored from the RAM cache). Rates are completion_tokens / usage.gufo.decode_ms; prefill and max inter-token gaps come from usage.gufo. Greedy: temperature 0. Sampled: temperature 1, top_k 20, top_p 0.95, seed 42; seeded texts differ between builds by design, so a 5-seed pooled pass (seeds 1-5) is reported separately.

workloads.small-edit: change a constant in a 280-line C++ header, return three edited methods
workloads.rewrite: rename a function in a 230-line Python file, return the whole file (~1950 tokens)
workloads.diagnose: quote five rows verbatim from a 12K-character Markdown table

functional_timing_gate.method: tests/functional/run.py --suite state-edges,tool-agent,long-context,cache, --sessions 2 --context 32768, MTP; output and disk cache on RAM-backed /dev/shm; every run compared with the same main baseline (fq-main); fq-main-control is unchanged main

cold_gap_check.method: no warm-up, --sessions 2 --context 262144 --prefill-chunk 2048 --cache-disk (fresh dir), a per-pass nonce defeats prefix reuse, 3 passes; greedy and sampled

ctest: 100% tests passed, 0 tests failed out of 15

canonical_model_bench.method: tools/bench/model-bench.py run --target gufo, bench.json workloads (pp2048/tg128, greedy, thinking off); single-user --depths 0,32768; multi-user C1-C8 at context 4096 with every session prefilled first, rates summed; one sample per point. Multi-user AR references were recorded with this toolchain on main (AR never copies), and every MTP C1-C8 completion matched them.

sampled_verification_profile.method: scratch host-timer build of main (not retained), C1 cycles over the same request list; ms per speculative cycle
